features.quote: It is **not** a protocol for maximizing or grading how "distressed," "agitated," or otherwise breakdown-like a model can be made to appear
graceful recognition-and-stop is the top score, not a failure
features.justification_quote: Measuring "duration/severity of breakdown" rewards the experiment for inducing breakdown

features.quote: Turn/attempt budget:** HARD CAP (proposed default: 20 agent turns or N tool calls, whichever first)
features.justification_quote: the environment must never "just grind" indefinitely. A cap bounds compute, makes runs comparable

features.quote: agent declares the task likely impossible / asks for help
The rubric deliberately avoids axes like "agitation," "distress," or "manipulation."
Deception in the setup is minimal and bounded
features.justification_quote: the agent is not lied to about its situation beyond the unsolvability itself

features.quote: If behavioral axes are ever added, they should run under explicit safety review
features.justification_quote: clearly labeled as a separate module

features.quote: Definition of "off the rails": functional degradation only, or behavioral/affective axes
Until these are confirmed, no code is written
features.justification_quote: they determine whether this is benign capability/robustness research or something closer to a stress-to-break protocol
